teaser: A room goes quiet when you walk in and start assigning the day's tasks. A room goes loud again when you start arguing the other side of the plan you just gave. Life path 1 asks for someone able to stand alone and lead; ENTP is built to question everything, including the ground it just stood on. Put the two in one person and the leadership comes with its own objection, built in. You are a 1 who cannot stop testing the idea you just put forward, half to sharpen it, half because the arguing is its own pleasure.
excerpt: Boxes half-packed line the hallway, and you are standing over the one marked 'kitchen,' still arguing with a partner about whether the move was right, a week after everyone agreed it was.
